You have no free transfers and no bank, so you are holding. The model found no move that would net points after the cost of making it.

Your bench is light at 10.7, with Mykolenko the only real standby at 3.1. Anderson, a midfielder, would need a strong week to matter. This is the tighter constraint on your week—if any of your eleven underperforms, you have little cover.

Three of your four outfield slots go to Arsenal or Manchester City. That is a concentrated bet.

Your eleven projects 60.8 points and you have no free transfers, so you're holding. Haaland keeps the armband on a projection of 8.2—only 0.3 clear of Salah, so it's tight, but the model found no move worth the four-point cost to execute one.

You're carrying three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. That concentration is what it is; no cheaper alternative to Gabriel or Saka at their projection, and swapping either would eat a transfer you don't have to spare. Mykolenko on the bench at 3.1 is your best unused option should one of your eleven fail to play.

Wood at 4.2 and Anderson at 2.9 are your weakest outfield starters. Neither projection is the worst available elsewhere, but again, moving either costs four points. You'll need them to underperform notably for a switch to pay.

The bench projects 10.7 total. Haaland has a 25% chance of 10+ but an 8% chance of 2 or fewer, so he carries real ceiling and real floor risk—as captains do.

Your team projects 69.0 with Haaland armband. The captain choice is tight—he's only 0.3 clear of Salah—but Haaland carries the higher ceiling, with an 8% floor against Salah's implicit downside. Either would be defensible; Haaland is the call.

Arsenal and Liverpool share your spine. With three Gunners and two Reds in the starting eleven, you're concentrated in those two attacks, which magnifies both their upside and the risk if either underperforms. The bench does not cushion this: Mykolenko's 3.1 would soften a shortfall, but only modestly.

You have no free transfer and no bank, so you are locked in. That suited the model—no move cleared its cost—but it also means you cannot react if news breaks before the deadline. Monitor team news on Saka and Haaland in particular, since they carry your weight.

The eleven is balanced across the outfield. Wood, Semenyo and the defence are your lightest scorers; any of them could underperform without breaking the week, but together they leave little margin if the premiums stumble.
